description: This script automates testing of cellular manager status before and after power cycling the SIM card, using qmicli commands to simulate power off/on and retrieving status via TR-181 parameters.

classes.name: TDKScriptingLibrary
classes.description: Wrapper class for TDK test scripts, used to load modules and create test steps.

methods.name: getLoadModuleResult
methods.description: Retrieves the load status of a module.

methods.name: configureTestCase
methods.description: Configures the test case with IP, port, and test name.

methods.name: createTestStep
methods.description: Creates a test step object for executing specific test commands.

methods.name: addParameter
methods.description: Adds parameters to a test step.

methods.name: executeTestCase
methods.description: Executes the test step and returns the result.

methods.name: getResult
methods.description: Retrieves the result status of the test step.

methods.name: getResultDetails
methods.description: Retrieves detailed output of the test step.

methods.name: setResultStatus
methods.description: Sets the pass/fail status of the test step.
